## Correlated Features

While awesome, permutation importance has one major flaw: **it struggles heavily with highly correlated features.**

Suppose _Number of Bedrooms_ and _House Size_ are highly correlated. If you shuffle _Number of Bedrooms_, the model can still use _House Size_ as a proxy to make a great prediction. The accuracy won't drop much, making _Number of Bedrooms_ look completely unimportant—even though it's a vital piece of information.

Furthermore, shuffling highly correlated features creates highly unrealistic data points (like a 500-square-foot house with 6 bedrooms), forcing the model to predict on data it would never see in the real world.
